types.description: Provisional generic 1-pole breaker; no selected hardware, ratings or protection suitability.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: 1 input/output pole pair(s), numbered by the existing core line/load convention. Closed state represents reset breaker poles with a terminal-free common trip mechanism. Optional: pole use by application; require both ends of every used pole in project review. No universal required points. Unmodeled: neutral, bonding, indicators and auxiliary interfaces. Author must select hardware and add voltage/AC/DC, current, trip characteristics, interrupting capacity and coordination data as applicable. No manufacturer pinout is asserted. L/T denote line and load side only, not phase or polarity.
